== Images and DjVu ==

Wiki image files live in the installation's `public/docs/image` directory. Supported raster formats include PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, and AVIF.

Bundled raster image:

[[image:demo.png|Bundled example icon]]

Example syntax for a raster image:

<pre><nowiki>[[image:demo.png|Bundled example icon]]</nowiki></pre>

The `img:` namespace is an alias, and names may include safe relative subdirectories:

<pre><nowiki>[[img:maps/toronto.png|Toronto map]]</nowiki></pre>

DjVu documents can be embedded with the page viewer. The document is fetched only when its placeholder scrolls near the viewport; each page is rendered locally in the browser using WebAssembly. The original file remains available through the download link.

Bundled DjVu reader:

[[djvu:djvu-smoke.djvu|Open the bundled DjVu sample]]

Example syntax for a DjVu file:

<pre><nowiki>[[djvu:djvu-smoke.djvu|Open the bundled DjVu sample]]</nowiki></pre>

The bundled smoke document is a small DjVu.js test asset under the Unlicense. To use your own documents, copy them into `public/docs/image` and replace `djvu-smoke.djvu` with the file name you added.
